content.value: In a steam power plant, following observations were made on boiler during one hour test: steam pressure= 18 bar, steam temperature ${ } = 2 5 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ Temperature of water entering the economizer $= 2 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ Temperature of water leaving the economizer $= 9 5 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ Dryness fraction of steam leaving the boiler $= 0 . 9 5$ , Mass of steam generated = 4500 kg, Mass of fuel used = 500 kg, Calorific value of fuel = 29000 $k J / k g$ Calculate: i) the equivalent evaporation rate per kg of fuel, ii) Overall efficiency of the plant, and iii) the percentage of the available heat utilized in the boiler, economizer and superheater respectively.
